title: The growth video list.
description: The five videos that teach marketing and distribution better than most paid courses, plus three bonus videos, with what each one covers and why to watch it.
formEyebrow: Get it free, in your inbox
disclosure: You will also get The Draft, one letter a week on how top 1% startups crush organic marketing. Leave whenever you like.

blocks.text: Marketing and distribution is the most valuable skill you can build in 2026, and the best material on it is free. You just have to dig it out from under a thousand worse videos.
I'm a partner at RallyUp, where we write LinkedIn for B2B founders and executives. When a founder asks me how to get better at marketing, these are the videos I send.

items: Alex Hormozi on the only four ways to get customers
Facebook's former VP of Growth on retention before acquisition
A YC partner on getting your first customers by hand
Rory Sutherland on why people actually buy
April Dunford's five steps to positioning
Three bonus videos on founder-led sales, marketing teams and modern GTM

blocks.text: I checked every link and running time by hand. Watch one, try one thing from it that week, and only then start the next.
Drop your email below and I'll send it over.
